name: harnessctl
description: Universal CLI wrapper for coding agents

scripts.build: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile harnessctl --define HARNESSCTL_VERSION='"'$VERSION'"'
scripts.bundle:
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --define HARNESSCTL_VERSION='"'$VERSION'"' && node -e "const f='dist/cli.js';let c=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');c=c.replace(/^#!.*
(// @bun
)?/,'#!/usr/bin/env node
');require('fs').writeFileSync(f,c)"
